title: REDOX Metabolism — Gaia Eats Code
philosophy: C is undigested data. Every foreign engine is FOOD, not a dependency. The primals don't USE Godot — they EAT Godot. Nothing remains as a dependency. Everything becomes tissue. The cool/dark/brown IS the fertile soil. Dead engines decompose into nutrients. The waste IS the food.
biology: This is METABOLISM — catabolism (break down foreign code) + anabolism (rebuild as primal tissue). sourDough ferments. sweetGrass catalogs the nutrients. The Rust compiler IS the gut acid.

1_intake.name: Intake — Mouth
1_intake.action: Find and acquire foreign code (git clone, winget install, PCK extract, decompile)

2_mastication.name: Mastication — Teeth
2_mastication.action: Break down source into patterns. Catalog scene trees, shaders, data structures, APIs. Strip away platform-specific crust.
2_mastication.produces: Pattern catalog (what does this engine DO, what patterns does it USE)

3_digestion.name: Digestion — Gut Acid (rustc)
3_digestion.action: Reimplement patterns in Rust. The compiler IS the gut acid — type-safe, memory-safe, no undefined behavior. Foreign C/C++ dissolves.

4_absorption.name: Absorption — Tissue Formation
4_absorption.action: Integrate new Rust code into the primal ecosystem. Scene trees → loamSpine. Shaders → petalTongue. Knowledge → sweetGrass.

5_excretion.name: Excretion — Compost
5_excretion.action: Original C/C++/Python source can be deleted. Only the Rust tissue remains. The foreign code was food, not furniture.
5_excretion.produces: data/eaten/{name}/ can be cleaned up after digestion

C_to_Rust.oxidation: C code loses its platform-specific pointers, manual memory, undefined behavior
C_to_Rust.reduction: Rust gains ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, type safety
C_to_Rust.energy: The conversion releases INSIGHT — understanding WHY the pattern exists

CSharp_to_Rust.oxidation: C# loses its .NET runtime, GC pauses, JIT overhead
CSharp_to_Rust.reduction: Rust gains zero-cost abstractions, no GC, WASM export

Python_to_Rust.oxidation: Python loses its GIL, dynamic typing, runtime overhead
Python_to_Rust.reduction: Rust gains parallelism, static types, native speed
Python_to_Rust.catalyst: PyO3 bridge during transition, pure Rust after digestion

GDScript_to_Rust.reduction: Rust gains independence — runs anywhere, compiles to WASM

tr49.rust_tissue: tube.html WebGL shader (interim), future petalTongue WASM crate
tr49.note: Still in data/eaten/tr49/ — patterns extracted, C# studied, not yet fully digested into Rust

patterns_extracted: Scene tree node system → loamSpine universal node
godot_4.7.note: Engine installed but used as scaffold — goal is full dissolution into primals

kenshi_ogre3d.target_tissue: petalTongue (3D rendering), coralReef (world building), bingoCube (squad coordination)
kenshi_ogre3d.redox_path: Ogre3D rendering patterns → Bevy/wgpu in Rust → petalTongue crate

retroarch.target_tissue: barraCuda (emulation as stream compute), petalTongue (retro display)
retroarch.redox_path: libretro API patterns → Rust emulator cores → barraCuda crate

blender.redox_path: Blender Python API patterns → Rust mesh/material structs → coralReef crate

the_goal.statement: FULL AGNOSTIC AND UNIVERSAL. The primals depend on NOTHING external. Every C line is food that hasn't been Rust'd yet. The cool dark brown of the interface IS the fertile soil — dead engines decomposing into nutrients.
the_goal.endstate: 17 primals in pure Rust. Zero external engine dependencies. petalTongue renders. sweetGrass knows. loamSpine stores. songBird speaks. bearDog guards. The organism IS the engine.

scaffold_tools.godot: Scaffold for learning scene trees. Will dissolve.
scaffold_tools.bevy: Scaffold for learning ECS. Will dissolve.
scaffold_tools.wgpu: Scaffold for learning GPU. May persist as low-level binding (like libc).
scaffold_tools.rustc: The gut acid. Does NOT dissolve — it IS the metabolism.

color_meaning.cool: The temperature of decomposition — slow, patient, thorough
color_meaning.dark: The absence of light in the soil — where roots grow unseen
color_meaning.brown: The color of humus — the richest soil, made from what died before
color_meaning.fertile: Every dead engine feeds the next generation of tissue
color_meaning.waste_is_food: There is no waste in a living system. Only nutrients in transit.
